stem.text: Halogenoalkanes show trends in their physical and chemical properties.
Which properties steadily increase from $\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{Cl}$ to $\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{Br}$ to $\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{I}$?

items: the polarity of the carbon-halogen bond
the boiling point of the halogenoalkane
the rate of reaction of the halogenoalkane with nucleophiles
